scope: Independent review of the existing WZ20 green map-selection outline; no source or runtime geometry replacement.

visual_review.observation: The whole map, overview and closeup show the same rendered green circle. Architecture controls, independent holdouts, masked gates and icon-obscured spans remain explicitly separated. The modeled circular closures support map selection, not physical walking routes.

cross_version_trial.scope: Cross-version numerical replay only; original approved production polygon retained.

cross_version_interpretation: OpenCV 5.1.0 changes the ellipse sampling phase and floating-point output. It is not a byte-identical replay. The original approved outputs were restored, then reproduced exactly with the original OpenCV 4.13.0 dependency. No cross-version outputs were promoted.
preservation: Existing candidate evidence, all failed trials, source photographs, approved geometry and production IDs remain unchanged.
release_validation: The final combined PR head still requires its own CI, actual browser screenshot review, merge and live checks.
